notes: Momentum scrolling for the Magic Mouse: flick and lift, and the page keeps gliding and slows to a stop like on macOS; touch the mouse to stop it, flick again to go faster
New Settings → Mouse & Trackpad page: Natural scrolling, Momentum scrolling, Swipe gestures and the green full-screen button, each with its own switch
New transitions: Control Center drops down from the menu bar, notifications slide in from the right, Spotlight pops in place, and the full-screen bar slides down
